name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog:
Reverted last release's attempt to move "Download to server" into jellyfin-web's own "more actions" (⋮) menu - cloning into that live popup ended up removing the rest of its options (Edit metadata, Edit images, Identify, etc.) for some users, which is a much worse outcome than a pill that just looked a little crowded. The native menu is untouched again.

Removed the floating "Origin filter" control entirely, per feedback that it wasn't wanted.

Download to server is back as its own pill next to Streamed-from/Hide, but redesigned to stop colliding with the title: it now renders on its own row directly below the title instead of jammed inline before it, so a stylized show-logo title has room and the pills read as a small action bar underneath rather than fighting the title for space.

Fixed download progress disappearing on refresh: the in-progress state is now saved (which item, which operation) so reloading the page - or coming back to the item later - resumes polling and restores the pill/toast instead of leaving no indication a download was ever running.

194 tests (unchanged - this release is client-script only, no server-side logic changed).
